blocks.text: for loop code ke block ko ek specific (pehle se tay) number of times dohrata hai. Aam taur par yeh kisi sequence (list, tuple ya string) ki har cheez par ek ek kar ke chalta hai.
Misaal 1: dosto ki list mein har dost ko "As-Salaam-Alaikum" kahein.

Wazahat: loop list ke har dost par baari baari chalta hai aur har ek ke liye salaam print karta hai: "As-Salaam-Alaikum Ahmad", phir "As-Salaam-Alaikum All", phir "As-Salaam-Alaikum Hassan". (Kitab mein naam "All" chhapa hai; shayad "Ali" likhna tha. Code dono tarah chalta hai.)
Misaal 2: shopping cart ki cheezon ki total price (kul qeemat) nikalein.

cart = [
    {"item": "Apple", "price": 0.5, "quantity": 4},
    {"item": "Banana", "price": 0.2, "quantity": 10},
    {"item": "Orange", "price": 0.75, "quantity": 3}
    ]
total_price = 0
for product in cart:
    item_total = product["price"] * product["quantity"]
    total_price += item_total
    print(f"{product['item']} total: ${item_total:.2f}")
print(f"Total price of all items: ${total_price:.2f}")

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab aakhri line print (f "Total price ...") chhapti hai, yani f aur quote ke beech space hai. Is se SyntaxError aata hai. f-string mein f bilkul quote ke saath likha jata hai: print(f"Total price of all items: ${total_price:.2f}").

Apple total: $2.00
Banana total: $2.00
Orange total: $2.25
Total price of all items: $6.25
blocks.caption: Output

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: cart ek list hai jis ki har cheez dictionary (key aur value ke jore) hai. Har product ke liye price * quantity se item_total banta hai (Apple 0.5 * 4 = 2.00) aur total_price mein jurta jata hai. f"..." (f-string) mein { } ke andar variable ki value aa jati hai, aur :.2f ka matlab hai decimal point ke baad do digits.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Python program likhein jo temperatures ki list par chale aur 20 degree se zyada par “Warm” aur 20 ya kam par “Cold” print kare.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: temperatures = [25, 18, 30, 20] ke liye program aur output.
blocks.explanation: for t in temperatures: (andar) if t > 20: print("Warm") else: print("Cold"). Output: Warm, Cold, Warm, Cold (20 "Cold" hai kyunke condition "20 se zyada" hai).

blocks.prompt: List jaisi collection par chalne ke liye kaunsa loop istemal hota hai (MCQ 6)?

items: for: sequence ki har cheez par ek baar.
